definition: To bring items from several people or places into one group.
example: Please collect one completed form from each team.

image.brief: Show a friendly worker gathering fictional completed forms from three separate teams into one folder. Keep the separate sources and the one growing set clear: one colleague hands over a form while forms from the other teams are already together. Use ordinary workplace characters, a folder and full-size form props from suitable sourced assets. Exclude a reception pickup of a preassembled bundle, money, hobby collections and private information. Do not depend on tiny labels or arrows to explain the action. This is a pending art brief; source selection and actual-size picture suitability still require review.
